topic: Orchestration patterns for LLM-based multi-agent systems
_query_note: arXiv API query syntax (ti: title, abs: abstract, cat: category). Title terms keep it on orchestration itself rather than applications that merely use agents.
query: (ti:"multi-agent" OR ti:multiagent OR ti:agents) AND (abs:LLM OR abs:"large language model") AND (ti:orchestration OR ti:coordination OR ti:collaboration OR ti:communication OR ti:topology OR ti:survey OR ti:framework) AND (cat:cs.MA OR cat:cs.AI OR cat:cs.CL)
_suggested_note: Widely cited papers the query misses (AutoGen, CAMEL, ChatDev, LLM multi-agent survey). Shown with a star in the checklist; you still decide.
default_question: What orchestration patterns do LLM-based multi-agent systems use, and how do they trade off control, cost and robustness?
